additional_info.subject: ID0479235-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP/R6 170002268] Error:secc pilot is E CRM:02889001130
additional_info.body:
Dear Poland Service Team,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and after checking the charging session mentioned, we see that the charging session was interrupted as the car wasn`t able to communicate with the charger.
See following logs:
In the case where the communication between the car and the charger (SSL handshake) gets lost, the charger automatically respond by shutting down the Ecog (secc).
This means this is a communication error as a respond to the charger failing to communicate to the car and the network.
We do see that the charger is healthy and no error flags are showing.
We hope to have informed you enough. Please provide us with feedback regarding the charger.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.body:
Dear Poland Service Team,
Thank you for your response.
The connection can get lost, because of an unstable network connection with the network provider, or because the router had trouble finding a signal.
You can check the following three casues:
1. The sim card of the charger
2. The internet cable of the charger.
3. The router of the charger.
We also want to inform you that the charger has no-warranty, and for that reason, we are only able to provide you with one-hour of support.
For that reason we will close this ticket.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
